name: Washer
description: Plain washers: an outside diameter, an inside diameter, and nothing else to say about them.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: @pick(4%, 14%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @pick(50%, 66%), #000 @pick(50%, 66%)); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @pick(50%, 66%), #000 @pick(50%, 66%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
